items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay says not making great progress and team being cautious though not long-term.
items.why: Hip injury, second consecutive DNP, McVay cautious.
items.implication: Likely OUT or GTD for Week 3; boosts Adams.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.implication: Likely full go; reverse any backup hype.

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% of routes and 28% team target share; faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.why: High usage in Collins absence + favorable matchup.
items.implication: Strong TE start/stream if Collins out.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and 16-5 touches rest of game; gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet.

items.text: Drake London averages over 20 PPR, 35% target share, 97 yards/game in 12 career games with Michael Penix.
Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated after 5-150-1 first half Week 1, hasn't practiced full since; Brazil this week.
items.why: Origin and aggravation details, travel concern.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart expected to have knee surgery ending 2026 season (ACL intact); Harbaugh confirms out foreseeable, possible playoffs longshot.
Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks placed on IR after core muscle surgery; out at least 6 weeks.
Hurt list: WRs/TEs/QBs include Nacua, Collins, Bowers, AJ Brown, Flowers, Daniels, Williams, Dart, Reed, Murray, Pierce, Pittman, Goedert etc.; RBs meh committees Brooks, Dowdle, Mason.
items.implication: Multiple high-value players sidelined impacting waivers/starts.

items.text: TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Penix healthy enough to revive London/Pitts? Reed absence more 2TE? OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.implication: Monitor snaps for Lloyd/Johnson, London/Pitts boost.
items.opportunity: Potential expansion for London/Pitts with Penix.

items.text: MarShawn Lloyd averaging 38% snaps and 10.5 touches through 2 weeks; same RZ touches as Brooks, fewer rushes than Kaleb Johnson in Week 2.
items.implication: Not full lead; monitor vs Johnson.
